The Correct Spreadsheet template

The Correct Spreadsheet template

Corrected a bug in the quadratics spreadsheet

Corrected a bug in the blockage correction factor for HGVs and LCVs (the car area was being used in cells J13 and J14 in the earlier spreadsheets).
The .ods spreadsheet is the master version.

CORRECTED SPREADSHEETS AND CORRESPONDING SCRIPTS

- Corrected column header name in spreadsheet providing the sheath
  height
- Corrected the names of spreadsheet files being referenced by the
  function that generates and loads the LUTs

a few updates from the lao translator

After sending off the spreadsheet, these updates reflect the corrected spreadsheet that I got back

rest-gateway: correct paths incorrectly specified in spreadsheet

The URL mapping spreadsheet incorrectly stated that these URLs used
underscores where they use dashes. Correct these paths.

Bug: T350747

Following odoo/o-spreadsheet@ea578b, The parser only supports normalized formulas, we had to adapt the code
that converts functions to create/load formulas in templates.
